description: This file defines the ConfigurationDomainService interface for the Fineract project, specifying configuration-related methods and constants used across the system.

classes.name: ConfigurationDomainService
classes.description: Interface declaring configuration-related methods for the Fineract system.

methods.name: isMakerCheckerEnabledForTask
methods.description: Checks if maker-checker process is enabled for a specific task.

methods.name: getAllowedLoanStatusesForExternalAssetTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves list of allowed loan statuses for external asset transfer.

methods.name: getAllowedLoanStatusesOfDelayedSettlementForExternalAssetTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves list of allowed loan statuses for delayed settlement in external asset transfer.

methods.name: isSameMakerCheckerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the maker-checker process is enabled system-wide.

methods.name: isAmazonS3Enabled
methods.description: Checks if Amazon S3 integration is enabled.

methods.name: isRescheduleFutureRepaymentsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if rescheduling of future repayments is enabled.

methods.name: isRescheduleRepaymentsOnHolidaysEnabled
methods.description: Checks if rescheduling repayments on holidays is enabled.

methods.name: allowTransactionsOnHolidayEnabled
methods.description: Checks if transactions on holidays are allowed.

methods.name: allowTransactionsOnNonWorkingDayEnabled
methods.description: Checks if transactions on non-working days are allowed.

methods.name: isConstraintApproachEnabledForDatatables
methods.description: Checks if constraint approach for datatables is enabled.

methods.name: isEhcacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Ehcache caching is enabled.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Updates the specified cache type.

methods.name: retrievePenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the penalty wait period.

methods.name: isPasswordForcedResetEnable
methods.description: Checks if forced password reset is enabled.

methods.name: retrievePasswordLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves the password live time.

methods.name: retrieveGraceOnPenaltyPostingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the grace period for penalty posting.

methods.name: retrieveOpeningBalancesContraAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the contra account for opening balances.

methods.name: isSavingsInterestPostingAtCurrentPeriodEnd
methods.description: Checks if savings interest is posted at the end of the current period.

methods.name: retrieveFinancialYearBeginningMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the month when the financial year begins.

methods.name: retrieveMinAllowedClientsInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum allowed clients in a group.

methods.name: retrieveMaxAllowedClientsInGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum allowed clients in a group.

methods.name: isMeetingMandatoryForJLGLoans
methods.description: Checks if meetings are mandatory for JLG loans.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves the rounding mode used in calculations.

methods.name: isBackdatePenaltiesEnabled
methods.description: Checks if backdating penalties is enabled.

methods.name: isOrganisationstartDateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if organization start date feature is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveOrganisationStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the organization start date.

methods.name: isPaymentTypeApplicableForDisbursementCharge

methods.name: isInterestChargedFromDateSameAsDisbursementDate
methods.description: Checks if interest charged date is same as disbursement date.

methods.name: isSkippingMeetingOnFirstDayOfMonthEnabled
methods.description: Checks if skipping meeting on the first day of the month is enabled.

methods.name: isInterestToBeRecoveredFirstWhenGreaterThanEMI
methods.description: Checks if interest is recovered first when greater than EMI.

methods.name: isPrincipalCompoundingDisabledForOverdueLoans
methods.description: Checks if principal compounding is disabled for overdue loans.

methods.name: retreivePeriodInNumberOfDaysForSkipMeetingDate
methods.description: Retrieves the period in days for skipping meeting date.

methods.name: isChangeEmiIfRepaymentDateSameAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if changing EMI when repayment date is same as disbursement date is enabled.

methods.name: isDailyTPTLimitEnabled
methods.description: Checks if daily TPT limit is enabled.

methods.name: getDailyTPTLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the daily TPT limit.

methods.name: removeGlobalConfigurationPropertyDataFromCache
methods.description: Removes global configuration property data from cache.

methods.name: isSMSOTPDeliveryEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SMS OTP delivery is enabled.

methods.name: isEmailOTPDeliveryEnabled
methods.description: Checks if email OTP delivery is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveOTPCharacterLength
methods.description: Retrieves OTP character length.

methods.name: retrieveOTPLiveTime
methods.description: Retrieves OTP live time.

methods.name: isSubRatesEnabled
methods.description: Checks if sub-rates are enabled.

methods.name: isFirstRepaymentDateAfterRescheduleAllowedOnHoliday

methods.description: Checks if external ID auto-generation is enabled.

methods.name: isAddressEnabled
methods.description: Checks if address feature is enabled.

methods.name: isCOBBulkEventEnabled
methods.description: Checks if COB bulk event is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveExternalEventBatchSize
methods.description: Retrieves external event batch size.

methods.name: retrieveReportExportS3FolderName
methods.description: Retrieves S3 folder name for report export.

methods.description: Retrieves accrual date configuration for charges.

methods.name: getNextPaymentDateConfigForLoan
methods.description: Retrieves next payment date configuration for loans.

methods.description: Checks if immediate charge accrual after maturity is enabled.

methods.description: Retrieves strategy for outstanding interest transfer for asset owner.
